correctness.rationale: The plane-sextic partial derivatives prove geometric smoothness precisely for t^3 != 6. Adjunction gives genus 10 and a ten-element basis. The standard Hasse--Witt coefficient extraction from F^10 yields three A scalar blocks, three B exchange blocks and one C scalar block, where A=t^2(1-t^3), B=2t(2t^3+1), C=t(t^3-1)(t^3+2)(t^3+4) modulo 11. This gives the exact determinant 9 t^13(t^3-1)^4(2t^3+1)^6(t^3+2)(t^3+4), and the block support proves p-rank equals one-step rank over the algebraic closure, including semilinear twists. The attached pure-Python verifier reconstructs coefficients in homogeneous and affine coordinates, checks all entries and determinant, and tests rational fibers and stabilized ranks. Roots, Frobenius degrees and multiplicities follow symbolically, not from partial enumeration.

originality.rationale: The 2017 Bouyer--Costa--Festi--Nicholls--West source establishes the branch pencil and characteristic-zero K3 Picard/singularity structure, not characteristic-eleven branch-curve Hasse strata. Bartoli--Giulietti--Kawakita--Montanucci (2019), Section 5, studies the genus-ten sextic family and gives Jacobian isogeny factors and maximality examples, but no exact characteristic-eleven Hasse divisor, parameterwise ranks or multiplicity pattern. Badr--Bars (2025) classifies automorphism groups only for characteristic zero or above 21 and therefore cannot imply the positive-characteristic 11 rank classification. Published mathematical-record hits concern different curves or characteristics. A prior unindexed computation is still possible.

value.rationale: The natural genus-ten branch curve pencil occurs simultaneously in an arithmetic K3 family and a maximal-curve/Jacobian-isogeny construction. A complete nonordinary scheme divisor of degree 49 with four distinct multiplicity types, a unique superspecial coefficient, and precise geometric ranks 0,4,6,9,10 addresses a motivated arithmetic-geometric invariant. The proof gives a structural Frobenius block decomposition valid over the entire algebraic closure, not an isolated computed example or an unsupported claim about K3 Newton polygons.
